description: Fetch selected CC0 ActionForge rig/animation GLBs into a project with atomic files, binary glTF v2 validation and SHA-256 provenance; animation authoring, retargeting and engine import stay manual.
requires: write access to the target project
checks: binary glTF magic is glTF and version is 2
GLB header length equals the received byte count
destination resolves inside the project root
SHA-256 and byte count recorded for every file
differing existing file is not overwritten without --force
rerun with identical bytes leaves provenance unchanged
download failure or invalid GLB fails the fetch honestly
